io.writer

Class AppendWorkbook

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.writer.AbstractWorkbook
      • io.writer.WriteWorkbook
        • io.writer.AppendWorkbook
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ExcelWritable, Writable, java.lang.AutoCloseable

    public final class AppendWorkbook
extends WriteWorkbook
    Extends the WriteWorkbook class to append a new worksheet tab to an existing Excel spreadsheet instead of overwriting the workbook, or create a new workbook when the target file does not exist.

    Supports both binary XLS and OOXML XLSX workbook formats.

    Change log:
    • 26 June 2018 - Initial creation.
    • 7 October 2026 - Refactored package to io.writer, updated exception handling to TabularDataException and migrated stream handling to NIO Files.
    Since:
    26 June 2018
    Version:
    0.5
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs
